content.short: Acentrik is a data marketplace that provides secure private data exchanges.
content.description: Acentrik is a Web3 data marketplace operating on the Polygon mainnet that enables data monetization for its users. The platform provides analytics capabilities that help users craft new products and generate fresh revenue streams, while developers can access product insights through a data-driven workflow. Crucially, unlike many other tools, users’ data assets remain on premises, guaranteeing data sovereignty and empowering users to control access and reuse of their data.
